claims: Good Friday is not a federal holiday in the United States.
Federal government offices remain open and operate normally on Good Friday.
The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) remains open and operates normally on Good Friday.
Most banks remain open and operate normally on Good Friday.
Good Friday is recognized as a state public holiday in over a dozen states.
The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) is closed on Good Friday.
Nasdaq is closed on Good Friday.
USPS operates on its normal schedule on Good Friday.
UPS operates on its normal schedule on Good Friday.
FedEx operates on its normal schedule on Good Friday.
Most retail stores remain open on Good Friday.
Most restaurants remain open on Good Friday.
CT recognizes Good Friday as a state holiday.
NJ recognizes Good Friday as a state holiday.
TX recognizes Good Friday as a state holiday.
TN recognizes Good Friday as a state holiday.
